purpose: Exact reviewed non-Project identity coverage embedded in Schedule project-reference rows, kept strictly separate from Project/Deployment role bindings.

semantics.coverage: identity_coverage_ids records exact current State-safe Agency/Institution/Organization surfaces embedded in a project-reference row; these IDs are representational coverage only and are never project-role bindings.
semantics.source_binding: Every reviewed source is pinned to its exact Git blob; source drift invalidates the overlay.
semantics.non_inference: Coverage creates no participation, operation, control, membership, supply, culpability, evidence, hierarchy or governance inference.
